description: Reference model for an archive, consisting of an organization of people and systems that has accepted the responsibility to preserve information and make it available

entities.name: Submission Information Package
entities.description: Information package delivered by the Producer to the OAIS for use in the construction of one or more AIPs
entities.note: SIP is transformed into AIP during ingest process

entities.name: Archival Information Package
entities.description: Information package preserved within an OAIS, consisting of Content Information and associated PDI

entities.name: Dissemination Information Package
entities.description: Information package delivered to the Consumer in response to a request
entities.note: Derived from one or more AIPs

entities.name: Content Information
entities.description: The original target of preservation, consisting of Content Data Object and Representation Information

entities.name: Content Data Object
entities.description: The Data Object that together with its Representation Information constitutes the original target of preservation

entities.name: Representation Information
entities.description: Information that maps a Data Object into more meaningful concepts

entities.name: Preservation Description Information
entities.description: Information necessary for adequate preservation of the Content Information

entities.name: Provenance Information
entities.description: Information documenting the history of the Content Information

entities.name: Context Information
entities.description: Information that documents the relationships of the Content Information to its environment

entities.name: Reference Information
entities.description: Information used as an identifier for the Content Information

entities.name: Fixity Information
entities.description: Information describing mechanisms ensuring that the Content Information has not been altered

entities.name: Access Rights Information
entities.description: Information identifying the access restrictions pertaining to the Content Information

entities.name: Packaging Information
entities.description: Information used to bind the components of an Information Package together

entities.name: Descriptive Information
entities.description: Information that facilitates finding, ordering, or understanding the archived information

entities.name: Physical Object
entities.description: An object that has physical presence

entities.name: Digital Object
entities.description: An object composed of a set of bit sequences

entities.name: Structure Information
entities.description: Information that describes the data structure of the Data Object

entities.name: Semantic Information
entities.description: Information that provides further meaning beyond structural information

functionalEntities.name: Ingest
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions that accept SIPs and prepare contents for storage and management

functionalEntities.name: Archival Storage
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions for storage, maintenance and retrieval of AIPs

functionalEntities.name: Data Management
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions for populating, maintaining and accessing Descriptive Information and administrative data

functionalEntities.name: Administration
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions for overall operation of the archive system

functionalEntities.name: Preservation Planning
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions for monitoring the environment and providing recommendations for preservation strategies

functionalEntities.name: Access
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions that support Consumers in determining the existence, description, location and availability of information and allowing Consumers to request and receive information products

packageTypes.SIP: Submission Information Package - from Producer to Archive
packageTypes.AIP: Archival Information Package - preserved within Archive
packageTypes.DIP: Dissemination Information Package - from Archive to Consumer

accessLevels.Open: Freely accessible to all designated communities
accessLevels.Restricted: Access limited to specific users or groups
